answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 24869 Country: India Title: My college comes in and is 6km from city we daily pray zohar but on friday some students have after noon periods (and masjid is at 2km from college )and some has labs those who has periods they can go to masjid by bunking(leaving) the class but it is not possible with those who have labs if we bunk the lab we detain from college shall we pray jumah in college by giving Qutbah (we are atlest 10 members) or not what should we do and i hear that who doesn't pray continous three jumahs allahtaala will put mohar on his heart JAZAKALLAH keenly waiting for early reply Question: my college comes in and is 6km from city we daily pray zohar but on friday some students have after noon periods (and masjid is at 2km from college )and some has labs those who has periods they can go to masjid by bunking(leaving) the class but it is not possible with those who have labs if we bunk the lab we detain from college shall we pray jumah in college by giving Qutbah (we are atlest 10 members) or not what should we do and i hear that who doesn't pray continous three jumahs allahtaala will put mohar on his heart JAZAKALLAH keenly waiting for early reply Answer ID: 24869 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1432/971/L=1431) If your college is located in a city or big village, then Jumuah is fardh on you. In this case, you can offer Jumuah salah in your college. And if your college is not located in a city or big village rather it is in a small village, then Jumuah is not fardh on you and it is not necessary for you to go to city to offer Jumuah salah. It is enough if you offer Zuhar salah there with jamah. However, it is better for you if you invite at least two Muftis graduated from Darul Uloom Deoband or Mazahir Uloom Saharanpur to survey the place. After their survey, follow their opinion regarding the starting of Jumuah salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
